parameters.name: PortIDSubtype
parameters.description: The port identifier subtype, which is included in the value of the ''LLDPDU's'' Port ID TLV (TLV Type = 2). The following subtype values are defined: * ''0'' (Reserved) * ''1'' (Interface alias) * ''2'' (Port component) * ''3'' (MAC address) * ''4'' (Network address) * ''5'' (Interface name) * ''6'' (Agent circuit ID) * ''7'' (Locally assigned) * ''8-255'' (Reserved)

parameters.name: PortID
parameters.description: The port identifier, which is included in the value of the ''LLDPDU's'' Port ID TLV (TLV Type = 2).

parameters.name: TTL
parameters.description: The ''LLDPDU'' lifetime (in {{units}}), which is the value of the latest TimeToLive TLV (TLV Type = 3). If this value is 0, it means that the LLDP agent or the MAC service function of the port is stopped.

parameters.name: PortDescription
parameters.description: The port description, which is the value of the latest Port Description TLV (TLV Type = 4), or {{empty}} if no Port Description TLV has been received. Note: It is assumed that this string might be used for HTIP (Home-network Topology Identifying Protocol) {{bibref|JJ-300.00}} and {{bibref|G.9973}}. In this case, the parameter value is likely to be one of the names defined in {{bibref|JJ-300.00|Appendix A (''List of Interface Standard Names'')}}.

parameters.name: MACAddressList
parameters.description: The device's MAC addresses, which are included in the value of the ''LLDPDU's'' Organizationally Specific TLV (TLV Type = 127), or {{empty}} if no list of MAC addresses has been received. The parameter is relevant when there is a LLDP device which has a MAC copy function and has two or more MAC addresses. Note: It is assumed that it might be used for HTIP (Home-network Topology Identifying Protocol) {{bibref|JJ-300.00}} and {{bibref|G.9973}}. In this case, the {{bibref|OUI}} in the third octet is E0271A (''TTC-OUI'') and the organizationally defined subtype in the sixth octet is 3 (''MAC Address List'').

parameters.name: LastUpdate
parameters.description: The date and time at which the last LLDPDU was received for this ({{object|#}},{{object}}).

object.description: This table contains information about ports on discovered LLDP devices.
